---
name: Data issue
about: A price is wrong, missing or stale for a specific instrument
title: "Data: "
labels: data
---

## Instrument

Ticker code (for example `CU.SHF`, `PVC`, `SMR20`) and name.

## Date(s) affected

## What Tracky shows

Value, unit and currency as displayed. Note whether a currency other than "Local" was selected.

## What the source shows

Value and unit as published, with a link to the source page for that date.

## Type of problem

- [ ] Wrong value
- [ ] Missing date
- [ ] Not updating (stale)
- [ ] Wrong unit or currency conversion
- [ ] Other

## Additional context

Any banner shown in Tracky (for example "Feed error"), or other instruments from the same source
that look affected.
